risk_note: RV2 orders / settlement rights (FU-ORDER-REASON-SUB-ADMIN; rulings D10-818 ③, D10-819 ①③, D10-944, D10-957). Operator-chosen order sub-reason: a punish rights import accepts an optional reason_sub (PUNISH's 12 values or none; any other value, or one on a rights / channel import, is 20001 fields=[reason_sub]) and stores it on rights_imports; the import task carries it on each order_rights row (reason_sub, reason_sub_manual = true, 0131 CHECK). When a record lands an order on reason === 'PUNISH' (void or clawback) a manual choice wins over the automatic mapping of #2724 and sets orders.reason_sub_manual; REFUND / RIGHTS / other reasons are never touched. A stored PROCESSING row resolved by a later input keeps its manual choice, and an incoming manual choice is written back onto the row (money r1 S2 ②). A duplicate import of the same punishment number that explicitly carries a choice overrides an ended PUNISH order's value, manual over manual by the latest import, with an order_reason_sub_set audit (source rights_import, import id, old -> new, actor = the import's creator) on the same transaction (D10-957); a duplicate without a choice only refines automatically and never touches a manual value. adminSetOrderReasonSub (POST /admin/v1/orders/{order_id}/reason-sub, order.claim) changes only orders.reason_sub / reason_sub_manual with an audit. No amount, status, reason, balance, ledger entry, R6 or clawback is written on any sub-reason path. No migration (0131 is on main). Integration reason-sub-manual plus the related frozen order / settlement directories 599/599 pass; api unit 4756 pass.
